Xidhi iyaga in Android ee Bluetooth settings, ka dibna riix "Try": dhawaaqa waa in ay soo baxaan ee earbuds. app ma doortaan natiijada iyada oo aan xakamayn badhamada earbud. Waa maxay mic la isticmaalayo (telefonka ama earbuds) ku xiran tahay Android.
s.p.voyage.title: Socdaal
s.p.voyage.sub: U diyaari safarkaaga oo ka dhig inaad halkaas ku fahanto.
s.p.voyage.st_builtin: ✅ Built-in erayo: la heli karo xitaa offline.
s.p.voyage.st_ready: ✅ {n} erayo diyaariyey on {d}: la heli karo offline.
s.p.voyage.st_partial: ⚠️ {n} ka mid ah {t} erayo diyaariyey. Dhamaystirka diyaarinta la internetka.
s.p.voyage.st_none: Erayada aan wali la heli karin luqaddaan.
s.p.voyage.prep_note: Automatic online translation (free MyMemory adeegga), marka la sameeyo ka dibna waxaa lagu hayaa telefoonkan. Ka hubi macluumaad muhiim ah.
s.p.voyage.e_offline: Xidhiidh la'aan: diyaarinta waxay u baahan tahay Internetka. Dib u isku day marka aad xidhiidho.
s.p.voyage.e_quota: Qiimaha maalinlaha ah ee adeegga tarjumaadda bilaashka ah oo la gaadhay: {n} erayada la ilaaliyo. Haddaba dib u eegto berri.
s.p.voyage.e_other: diyaarinta joojiyey ({m}): {n} erayo la ilaaliyo. Dib u eegista.
s.p.voyage.step5: Ogoow aasaaska ka hor intaadan ka bixin
s.p.voyage.no_voice: Taleefankan ma leh codka ee afkan: qoraalka weli waa la muujin karaa (“Show” badhanka).
s.p.voyage.talk_d: Wadahadalka dhinac-iyo-laab ah, afka dalka ayaa horey loo dhigay
s.p.voyage.low_t: Xidhiidh daciif ah ama aan jirin
s.p.voyage.low_ok: Shaqada offline: built-in iyo erayo diyaarsan, badhanka "Show", settings aad.
s.p.voyage.low_partial: Waxaa ku xiran telefoonka: codka (“Hel”) shaqooyinka offline kaliya haddii codku waa la rakibay on telefoonka.
s.p.voyage.low_no: U baahan yahay Internetka: tarjumaadda eray cusub, mic ( aqoonsiga hadalka), wicitaanada in Messages.
s.p.voyage.found0: Ma jiraan erayo la mid ah “{q}”.
s.p.voyage.fav_on: Ka saar kuwa la jecel yahay: {p}
s.p.voyage.fav_off: Ku dar liiska la jecel yahay: {p}
s.p.voyage.fav_none: Hase yeeshee, ma jiro erayo aad jeceshahay. Taabo ☆ oo ku xiga erayga si aad u haysato halkan.
s.p.voyage.not_ready: Not translated yet: diyaar u ah offline la internetka.
s.p.voyage.hint: Automatic translation: hubi macluumaad muhiim ah (saaxiibtinimo, allergies, cinwaan).
s.p.learn.title: Barto
s.p.learn.sub: Wax ka baro aan xad lahayn.
s.p.learn.load_err: Waxyaabaha ku jira lama soo dejin karo.
s.p.learn.start_title: Waa maxay afka aad rabto inaad barato?
s.p.learn.start_txt: Dooro luqadda iyo heerka: fasalkaaga koowaad ayaa sugaya.
s.p.learn.all_done: Waxbarashada oo dhan ee heerkan ayaa la sameeyey.
s.p.learn.m_learn_d: Waxbarasho ku saleysan mawduuc, erayo, ereyga
s.p.learn.local_note: Horumarkaaga waxaa lagu kaydiyaa qalabkan. Isdhexgalka la xisaabtaada ayaa ah tallaabada xigta.
s.p.learn.score: {s} jawaabaha saxda ah ka mid ah {t}
s.p.learn.res_try: Wax kasta oo aad isku daydo waxay kaa caawineysaa inaad horumar sameyso. Ku dadaal mar kale markaad doonto.
s.p.learn.rev_txt: Su'aalaha laga soo qaatay qaladaadka iyo waxbarasho dhamaatay.
s.p.learn.rev_empty: Dhameystir fasalka koowaad: dib u eegista isticmaali doonaa erayada.
s.p.learn.def_txt: 8 su'aalood oo ku saabsan erayada heerkaaga. diyaar?
s.p.learn.q_listen: Dhagayso, ka dibna dooro waxa aad maqasho.
s.p.learn.ai_p1: Goor dhow: ku hadli qoraalka la saaxiibtinimo AI, in afka iyo heerka aad doorato, on theme (socdaal, shaqada, nolosha maalinlaha ah). Codku waa soo socda.
s.p.learn.ai_p2: Maxaa hadda ma? A hadalka AI u baahan yahay adeegga dibadda ah. Fududeeda waa in ay qarsoodi ku sii joogaan server, marnaba website-ka. Waxba ma la beddelo iyo wax kharash ah oo aan oggolaanshahaada lahayn.
s.p.learn.cult_p1: Wakhti gaaban: dalalka iyo gobollada, dhaqanka, sheekooyinka, maqaalka iyo fiidiyowyada, ogaanshaha luqadaha.
s.p.learn.cult_p2: Waxyaabaha waxaa loo abaabulay sida waxbarashada: mid ka mid ah faylka theme kasta, oo aan la bedelin app.
s.p.learn.pair_bad: Taasi ma aha labada saxda ah.
s.p.learn.no_voice: Hadalku ma jiro qalabkan. Maqaalka la maqli doono:
s.p.profil.title: Xirfadda Afka
s.p.profil.sum_empty: Noogu sheeg luqadahaaga: Wajiga in wajiga iyo Waxbarashada si ay ula jaan qaadaan.
s.p.profil.priv_contacts: 👥 Afaf la arki karo oo lala xidhiidhiyo
s.p.profil.pseudo_note: Magaca isticmaalahaaga dadweynaha waa mid ka mid ah fariimahaaga (ku dheji farriimaha). Magaca lagu muujiyo waa ikhtiyaari.
s.p.profil.name: Magaca lagu muujiyo (wax doorasho ah)
s.p.profil.level_hint: Heerka is-sheegay, heerka Yurub (A1 bilow → C2 xakamaynta).
s.p.profil.levels: A1 · Bilow (eray, erayo fudud)|A2 · Elementary (nolosha maalinlaha ah)|B1 · Dhexe (socdaal, hadal fudud)|B2 · Sare dhexdhexaad ah (waxbarasho si fudud)|C1 · Advanced (ugu yaraan wax walba)|C2 · Xirfadda (sida qof deggan)
s.p.profil.already: Afkan ayaa horey u ku jira liiska.
s.p.profil.ui_note: Bogga internetka waxaa ku jira 11 luqadood; Rasuullada wuxuu bixiyaa 31 (sicirka isku midka ah).
s.p.profil.e_off: xisaab aan la heli karin goobtan
s.p.profil.fav_note: La siiyay markii ugu horeysay ee Wajiga in wajiga iyo Safarka (6 ugu badan).
s.p.profil.reading_note: Slow: erayo ka yar on screen in side-by-side wada hadalka, oo leh meel dheeraad ah. Fast: ereyo badan.
s.p.profil.prefer_note: "Tirinta" furayaasha keyboard si toos ah ugu xiran side-by-side wada hadalka.
s.p.profil.hands: Hands-free (Microphone u dhaqaaqaa qof kale oo keliya)
s.p.profil.sync_note: Off: profile aad ku nool tahay qalabkan. On: waxaa lagu kaydiyaa xisaabtaada si aad u hesho on qalabka kale. qof kale ma akhrisan karo.
s.p.profil.sync_need: Waxaad u baahan tahay 24/24 ONE WORLD xisaab (a username) si aad u badbaadiso xisaabta.
s.p.profil.vis_contacts: Xiriiradayda (afka hooyo, afka la hadlo iyo magaca lagu muujiyo oo keliya)
s.p.profil.vis_need_sync: Si aad ula xiriirto si aad u aragto luuqadahaaga, marka hore ku shub "Dhoofinta xisaabteyda".
s.p.profil.never: Ha ka muuqan: emaylkaaga, aaladahaaga, astaamahaaga, horumarkaada Waxbarashada.
s.p.profil.cancel_note: Waxba ma badbaadiyo ilaa aad taabato "Save".
s.p.profil.consent: Waxaan aqbalaa in profile-kayga luqadda lagu kaydiyaa server-ka mashruuca (Supabase, European Union) si aan ugu soo celiyo qalabka kale ee aan haysto. Waan ka qaadi karaa waqti kasta adoo ka dhigaya sync off: koontada server-ka ayaa markaas la tirtiri doonaa.
s.p.profil.consent_need: Tixraac bogga oggolaanshaha si aad u kaydiso xisaabtaada, ama ka dhig isdhexgalka oo xiran.
s.p.profil.avatar_note: Avatar: astaantaada. Sawirada lama diro ama laguma kaydiyo.
s.p.profil.sync_err: Ku kaydsan qalabkan. Xisaabtaada lama cusbooneysiin karo ({m}). Dib u isku day ka dib.
s.p.profil.offline: Offline: ku kaydsan qalabkan oo kaliya. Taabo "Save" mar kale markii la xidhiidhay.
s.p.profil.erased_sync: Profile-ka luqadda ayaa laga tiriyay qalabkan iyo xisaabtaada.
